Class SideBar

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.VBox
cashier.SideBar
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class SideBar extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
Sidebar component for the cashier screen managing current order items, pricing calculations, employee assignment, and order submission.
Author:
Riley Schall, Sanjana Anand

      public void addItem(int id, String name, BigDecimal price, List<SideBar.Topping> toppings, String sweetness, String ice)
